title: Broadcastwell receipt
description: One of the three receipt kinds the verifier checks: an Index receipt from the Absence Index, a sample receipt from the fictional Kalvenor Systems sample, or a Decision Receipt for a shared run.

index.title: Index receipt (Absence Index, release 2026-09)
index.description: One published answer. Checked against one line of answers-2026-09.jsonl in the Zenodo record under DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22907695.

question.description: The question text as the Index published it.

captured_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC capture time, compared exactly.

excerpt.description: About 240 characters of the answer around the first mention, with markdown marks removed and spacing collapsed; '... ' before and ' ...' after when cut. Quoted evidence: the engine wrote it.

cited_urls.description: Up to three of the pages the answer cited, in the answer's order.

answer_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the full answer text, UTF-8, exactly as published.

sample.title: Sample receipt (the fictional Kalvenor Systems sample)
sample.description: One illustrative answer from the keyless sample export. Kalvenor Systems is a fictional company; the sample has no DOI.

answer_text.description: The full answer text; its SHA-256 is the receipt hash.

decision.title: Decision Receipt (a shared run)
decision.description: A run-level receipt: SHA-256 over all the run's stored receipts in a fixed order and field order, published on a read-only share link that verifies itself with ?verify=<hash>. The answer texts are not public.
